articles.title: Prompt Injection Patterns in LLM-Based QA Agents
articles.summary: Security researchers document four common injection vectors in agent-based testing tools when using untrusted test data, with mitigations for each.

articles.title: Vitest 2.1 reaches feature parity with Jest on CommonJS
articles.summary: After two years of gradual porting, the last CommonJS-only Jest features now work in Vitest, removing a barrier to migration for legacy monorepos.

articles.title: How Stripe's Observability Team Debugged a Cascading Test Timeout
articles.summary: A deep dive into root-causing why E2E tests started timing out after a database schema migration, revealing non-obvious interactions between ORM lazy-loading and fixture setup.
